name: Closing permanently after the 2024 season
tagline: Angelic Organics Farm, Popular CSA Serving Chicago, Suddenly Closes After Farmer's Stroke
description: In Woodstock, IL, Closing permanently after the 2024 season grows Honey and Eggs on an independent farm. The season runs through much of the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
